messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Listen,
just so you know,{01 00 00 05 00} I'm
gonna move out soon...
Thanks SO much for being 
good friends with me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oi, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Kuule,
et sa teaksid,{01 00 00 05 00} ma
kolin varsti ära...
Suur AITÄH, et olid
mu hea sõber,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Oh, gee whiz, {04 1f 00}...{01 00 00 05 00}
I'm really, really sorry!{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}This'll seem sudden...
But here's the deal: {01 00 00 05 00}I'm
gonna be moving out of
town soon, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}It was really great talking
with you and stuff, so
thanks, and take care!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Oi issand, {04 1f 00}...{01 00 00 05 00}
Mul on tõesti väga kahju!{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}See tuleb ootamatult...
Aga asi on nii: {01 00 00 05 00}ma
kolin varsti linnast
ära, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Sinuga oli tõesti tore
rääkida ja nii, nii et
aitäh ja hoia end!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, to tell you the truth,
I'm gonna be moving soon,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Now you're gonna have to
find someone else to cook
you totally tasty snacks!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Huh?{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}I've never cooked
for you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}ANYWAY...{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Thank you so
much for everything! I had
a lot of fun!{01 00 00 05 00} Really!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kuule, ausalt öeldes
kolin ma varsti ära,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Nüüd pead sa leidma kellegi
teise, kes sulle täiesti
maitsvaid suupisteid teeb!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Mis?{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}Ma pole sulle kunagi
süüa teinud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}IGATAHES...{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Suur aitäh
sulle kõige eest! Mul oli
palju lõbus!{01 00 00 05 00} Tõesti!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Neat!{01 00 00 0a 00} I can't wait to see
you again once I'm all
settled in, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Vahva!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ootan juba, et sind
jälle näha, kui olen
sisse elanud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I've gotta do what's right
for ME this time!{01 00 00 05 00} I'm really
sorry, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma pean seekord tegema,
mis on MULLE õige!{01 00 00 05 00} Mul on
tõesti kahju, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 16 00}You think I oughta change
my mind, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Do you really think I'm that
flighty, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Miiiiiiiiiiiis?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 16 00}Sa arvad, et ma peaksin
meelt muutma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Kas sa tõesti arvad, et ma
olen nii heitlik, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
